# Copper Ridge Outdoors — Company Context

- **What it is:** a specialty big-box retailer of outdoor & sporting goods — camping, hiking, footwear,
  apparel, cycling, and fishing/hunting basics. Roughly **340 stores** across the country.
- **Positioning:** mid-market; competes with the big outdoor chains on selection and staff expertise, not
  on lowest price. Slogan associates hear a lot: *"Gear up, get out."*
- **Store #4172 is the "Northgate" store** — a ~38,000 sq ft box in the Northgate Marketplace open-air
  center, Aurora Hills.

## Org structure (the chain of command above Marc)
- **Store Manager** (Marc) → **District Manager** [Renata Vasquez](../people/renata-vasquez.md) (12 stores)
  → **Regional Director** [Dale Whitfield](../people/dale-whitfield.md) (~5 districts) → VP Stores → corporate.
- Support functions sit outside the store line: **Loss Prevention** ([Victor Hultgren](../people/victor-hultgren.md)),
  **HR** ([Angela Foster](../people/angela-foster.md)), **Merchandising** ([Ben Tran](../people/ben-tran.md)).

## Core policies associates live by
- **Return policy:** 90 days with receipt for a full refund; Summit Rewards members get **365 days**;
  worn/used gear judged case-by-case by a manager. No-receipt returns → store credit at lowest 30-day price.
- **Dress code:** Copper Ridge branded polo or tee, closed-toe shoes; name badge always visible.
- **Price-match:** match any local competitor's advertised in-stock price; online marketplaces excluded.
- **Employee discount:** 30% off most gear, 40% during the two annual associate appreciation events.
- **Safety:** ladders and RTV/baler certification required before stockroom equipment use.

## Corporate programs
- **Summit Rewards** — the loyalty program. Sign-up rate at the register is a tracked KPI (target **30%**
  of transactions). Members drive most repeat sales; the new [Horizon rollout](../projects/pos-loyalty-rollout.md)
  ties loyalty into the POS.
- **Trailhead** — the internal training/LMS platform associates complete certifications on.
- **District contests** — quarterly sales pushes run by the DM; see [District Q3 Sales Contest](../projects/district-sales-contest.md).
- **Fiscal calendar:** retail 4-5-4 calendar; FY runs Feb–Jan. "Q3" for Copper Ridge is roughly Aug–Oct
  (the holiday build).
